Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

6. The nominee/heir will be paid-
7. Cover to which the
8. (i) the amount of appropriate Insurance employee was entitled atthe time of death; and
9. lumpsum and amount(s) as in the case of (a) above, for the period
10. (ii) till the date of death;
11. (iii) only the Insurance Cover, if death takes place before becoming
12. a member. - Paras. 11.7, 11.8 and 11.9.
10. To whom payable.(a) When there is a valid nomination to the nominee(s), in the manner indicated in the nomination.
